description: React component for displaying and managing a list of tasks, including filtering, status updates, creation, and deletion.

classes.name: TaskTableModel
classes.description: Model class representing the table state for tasks, including filters, sorting, and selection.

methods.name: handleCreateTask
methods.description: Navigates to the task creation page.

methods.name: reloadTasks
methods.description: Fetches task data based on current filters and sorting, updating the table model.

methods.name: onStatusSelectChange
methods.description: Handles bulk status change for selected tasks.

methods.name: onDeleteButtonClick
methods.description: Deletes selected tasks and refreshes the task list.
